title: Static Application Security Testing Report
note.none: No finding in the scanned files.
note.errors: The engine reported {count} errors, e.g. files it could not parse: {first}
rule.cakephp2-query-concatenation: SQL built with a variable in Model::query()
rule.cakephp2-conditions-string: Conditions string with a variable in find()
rule.cakephp2-redirect-request: Redirect to a value of the request
rule.cakephp2-render-request: View or element named by the request
rule.cakephp2-unserialize-request: unserialize() of a value of the request
rule.cakephp2-security-csrf-disabled: CSRF or form tampering check turned off
rule.cakephp2-view-unescaped-output: Variable printed in a view without h()
message.cakephp2-query-concatenation: SQL built from a string with a variable is passed to Model::query(). Use the values array of query() ($this->Model->query('... WHERE id = ?', [$id])) or find() with conditions arrays.
message.cakephp2-conditions-string: A conditions string with a variable is passed to find(). Use a conditions array (['Post.title' => $title]) so that the value is escaped.
message.cakephp2-redirect-request: A value of the request is passed to redirect(). Redirect only to paths of the application, e.g. with Router::url() of a route array, or check the URL against a list.
message.cakephp2-render-request: A value of the request is passed to render() or element(). A path in it can render any template. Map the value to a list of allowed views.
message.cakephp2-xml-build-variable: Xml::build() is called with a variable: a URL or a path in it is read. Pass ['readFile' => false] for a string of XML, and do not pass values of the request.
message.cakephp2-unserialize-request: A value of the request is passed to unserialize(): it can create objects of any class. Use json_decode().
message.cakephp2-security-csrf-disabled: The CSRF check or the form tampering check of SecurityComponent is turned off. Turn it off only for the actions that need it, e.g. with unlockedActions.
message.cakephp2-view-unescaped-output: A variable is printed in a view without h(). Escape it with h(), or use a helper that escapes.
